narrative.overview:
Envision is a restrained shadcn-style interface built from the semantic Tailwind v4 theme in frontend/src/index.css. Neutral zinc surfaces carry most of the interface. A concentrated blue marks action and selection, while borders and state changes provide structure without visual noise.

Light and dark themes use the same semantic roles. Components bind to those roles rather than fixed light-mode values, so project information remains legible in either theme.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic light and dark color roles authored in OKLCH.
A 4px spacing foundation and a computed 6–26px radius scale.
Zinc surfaces and borders before shadows.
Blue reserved for primary action, active navigation, and meaningful emphasis.

rules.name: The Blue Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue marks a meaningful action, selected location, or emphasized datum. It is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic Pairing Rule
rules.body: Every surface uses its matching foreground role, including cards, popovers, sidebars, controls, and their dark equivalents.

rules.name: The Source Rule
rules.body: frontend/src/index.css is the normative color and radius source. Keep this document and Paper tokens aligned when that file changes.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: Use Inter Variable for every role. Size and weight carry hierarchy.

rules.name: The Tightening Rule
rules.body: Keep tracking neutral through 18px, then tighten it gradually for larger roles.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: If a border or tonal shift explains the layer, do not add a shadow.

rules.name: The Radius-by-Component Rule
rules.body: Use the exact radius token chosen by the component implementation. Do not substitute the older 12px-control and 14px-card convention.

dos: Do bind component colors to semantic Tailwind tokens so light and dark themes stay synchronized.
Do preserve the 4px spacing base and the computed radius scale from --radius: 0.625rem.
Do reserve blue for action, selection, focus-adjacent emphasis, and ordered chart data.
Do use zinc surfaces and borders before adding elevation.
Do match implemented component sizes and states before documenting new variants.
donts: Don't reintroduce the previous stone palette; the frontend uses zinc neutrals.
Don't describe buttons as 12px-radius, 40px controls by default; the implementation is 26px and 36px.
Don't hard-code light colors into components that support dark mode.
Don't use Alert Red for ordinary priority or decoration.
Don't document components as implemented until they exist in frontend/.
